# FLOAT16_SQRT_HALF_PI

> Square root of the mathematical constant [π][@stdlib/constants/float16/pi] divided by 2 as a half-precision floating-point number.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var FLOAT16_SQRT_HALF_PI = require( '@stdlib/constants/float16/sqrt-half-pi' );
```

#### FLOAT16_SQRT_HALF_PI

Square root of the mathematical constant [π][@stdlib/constants/float16/pi] divided by `2` as a half-precision floating-point number.

```javascript
var bool = ( FLOAT16_SQRT_HALF_PI === 1.2529296875 );
// returns true
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var FLOAT16_SQRT_HALF_PI = require( '@stdlib/constants/float16/sqrt-half-pi' );

console.log( FLOAT16_SQRT_HALF_PI );
// => 1.2529296875
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
